verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a usage-based billing platform, since buyers in this category may ask whether they can run it themselves. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Metronome offers a self-hosted or on-prem deployment. Every item describes a hosted API, app, SDKs or integrations (ingest endpoint, webhooks, data export), and none of these is self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
